tasks.title: P0.2-NGv2 — Re-author the jailed-install oracle so its mock subprocess tracks first-call state in a mutable closure cell, not a class-body NameError
acceptance_criteria: Replace class MockCompletedProcess with a state-based return using a mutable closure cell in three tests.
Ensure no NameError occurs during pytest execution of the oracle.
Ensure all pre-existing assertions are preserved verbatim in intent.

spec.objective: Fix NameError in tests/ngv2/test_poc_runner_jailed_install.py by tracking first-call state inside a mutable closure cell captured by the mock function body.
functional_requirements: Replace the class-body first_call check in test_poc_runner_jailed_install_positive_lockfile with a closure cell.
Replace the class-body first_call check in test_poc_runner_jailed_install_lockfile_only_argv with a closure cell.
Replace the class-body first_call check in test_jailed_installation_with_detonation_re_run_pythonpath with a closure cell.
Construct the return value as a plain object or SimpleNamespace.
edge_cases: The first call must return the expected ModuleNotFoundError to trigger the installer.
Subsequent calls must return success and correct output.
non_goals: No changes to production code ngv2/poc_runner_live.py.
No new test scenarios or skips.
spec.implementation_notes: Use a dictionary state = {'first': True} inside the test, mutate and read it inside mock_run, and return types.SimpleNamespace.

test_spec.test_data_requirements: Test repos with requirements lockfiles created on the fly in tmp_path.

token_budget_ratio.note: Purely test file edits, so test budget is larger.

tasks._debug_stamping_reason: Task was only proposed by Gemini.
